name: Git Workbench
description: Review task-scoped workspace changes, or explore and operate on Git history, branches, remotes, and focused diffs.

permissions.reason: Read repository history and status, or the task-scoped workspace snapshot when Git is unavailable.
Initialize a repository or run explicit Git actions such as stage, commit, fetch, pull, push, branch, merge, tag, stash, cherry-pick, and revert in the selected workspace.
Reveal a user-selected workspace file or its nearest existing folder in the operating system file browser.
